capabilities: Fold a selected name[options] list into a clickable tag
Show options and their comments in a hover popup
Insert option lists through a form
Switch display mode per fold from the context menu
Browse, search and delete folds in a vault overview
disambiguation: Folds parameter lists inside code blocks, not the code blocks themselves.
extras: Desktop only (manifest sets isDesktopOnly: true). Fold records are kept in .obsidian/plugins/code-block-context-fold/data.json and include fragments of note text, so the file is gitignored; each vault keeps its own fold data.
problem: Long option lists written inside code blocks make notes hard to scan, and there is no way to collapse them without deleting or rewriting the text.
summary: Folds long name[options] lists inside code blocks into a clickable tag or a hover popup, with a vault-wide overview of all folds.
